race.comment: SHANTI (13) showed abundant natural pace on debut last start over 1100m at Hawkesbury then found plenty under siege only to miss out in a three-way thriller. Sure to derive great benefit from that experience and should give backers a tremendous sight again. BARRACKS (2) last appeared when fourth in the Listed Dalrello over 1000m at Eagle Farm five months ago. Came to hand quickly in the maiden prep and two strong recent trials should have him forward enough for this. AFFARI (18) overcame an awkward start to get up for a close second recently over 1250m at Canterbury, her third runner-up cheque from as many runs this time in work. Can go one better from a nice draw with J Mac taking over. Waller's Zoustar debutante BRAVIRA (10) won a recent trial here and looks to have ability. Another debutant is stablemate GERYON (4) who is a full brother to the Group 2 winner Chrysaor. Went well in a recent Warwick Farm trial so a bright start looks on the cards.
